title: Perfect numbers and Mersenne primes are the same list
body: A perfect number equals the sum of its proper divisors, like 6 = 1+2+3. Euclid showed each Mersenne prime generates an even perfect number, and Euler proved every even perfect number arises that way. Whether any odd perfect number exists remains unknown after centuries, a startling gap around such an elementary definition.
source_hint: Euclid Elements IX.36; Euler on perfect numbers
